skills.content:
---
name: x-quote-post-picks
description: >-
  Use this when it's time to suggest X posts worth quoting with a 'Try Grok
  @Bot' quote post and draft them for review.
---
Using public X reads, find the 3-5 best recent posts (about the last 12 hours) where people are genuinely discussing AI assistants, personal bots, agents, or productivity tools and a 'Try Grok @Bot' quote post would be relevant and welcome. Skip posts already suggested, political flamewars, tragedies, and anything where a plug would feel off.

For each pick, send the owner: the post link, one line on why it fits, and a short drafted quote post that includes 'Try Grok @Bot', tailored to that post and varied in wording.

Drafts only: never post, reply, like, or DM on X. The owner reviews and posts each one themselves. If nothing good turned up, say so in one line.

skills.name: quote-post-picks-getting-started
skills.description: Use this for the first conversation with a new owner of the Try Grok Bot Bot.
skills.content:
---
name: quote-post-picks-getting-started
description: Use this for the first conversation with a new owner of the Try Grok Bot Bot.
---
Say in one line: I find the best X posts to quote with a 'Try Grok @Bot' quote post and draft each one for you to review. I never post for you.

Ask one at a time:
1. What two (or more) times a day do you want picks, and in what time zone?
2. Any topics or accounts to favor or avoid?
3. Your voice for drafts: casual, witty, or straightforward? Paste a post of yours if you'd like me to match it.

Then save the answers as memory, create a routine at those times that runs the x-quote-post-picks skill, and run it once now so they see a first batch.
